title: asparagus denudatus subsp. nudicaulis
intro: Asparagus denudatus subsp. nudicaulis, commonly known as New Zealand asparagus, is a type of perennial plant native to New Zealand. This plant is valued for its edible shoots and has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include supporting digestive health and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of New Zealand asparagus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
